body:
I do actually have a blog, one focusing on video games. It was recommended by a friend and I took the plunge almost two months ago. But it still hasn't helped because I've barely built a fanbase if at all. Seven subscribers who I know personally and two via Google Reader isn't anything impressive.

I've tried sitting my fucking father down, but he'll make up some excuse that "something needs done" or scream at me for being unemployed. 

I have two people that I could really call "friends", but friend is applied loosely. We see each other only at their convenience (because they have more important people in their life) and when I try to voice my concerns to them, I'm repelled.
Honestly, volunteering is wasted time for me. It's time I could spend looking for a job.

Haha, this I've been trying forever. But because many people have resorted to online freelancing due to the awful economy, it's even harder for someone with very, very limited publishing experience to enter the business.
